title: freeswitch_scripting Module
content_markdown:
_freeswitch\_scripting_ is a helper module that exposes full control over the FreeSWITCH ESL interface to the OpenSIPS script.

It allows the OpenSIPS script writer to subscribe to generic FreeSWITCH ESL events as well as to run arbitrary FreeSWITCH ESL commands and interpret their results. It makes use of the [freeswitch](freeswitch) module for the management of ESL connections and event subscriptions.

Credits for the initial idea and working code samples providing both ESL events and commands go to Giovanni Maruzzelli <gmaruzz@opentelecom.it>.

exported_parameters.name: db_url
exported_parameters.description: An SQL database URL which the module will use in order to load a set of FreeSWITCH ESL sockets and their event subscriptions.

exported_parameters.name: db_table
exported_parameters.description: The SQL table name for this module.

exported_parameters.name: db_col_username
exported_parameters.description: The SQL column name for the "username" ESL connect information.

exported_parameters.name: db_col_password
exported_parameters.description: The SQL column name for the "password" ESL connect information.

exported_parameters.name: db_col_ip
exported_parameters.description: The SQL column name for the "ip" ESL connect information.

exported_parameters.name: db_col_port
exported_parameters.description: The SQL column name for the "port" ESL connect information.

exported_parameters.name: db_col_events
exported_parameters.description: The SQL column name for the comma-separated, case-sensitive FreeSWITCH event names which OpenSIPS will subscribe to.

exported_parameters.name: fs_subscribe
exported_parameters.description: Add a FreeSWITCH ESL URL to which OpenSIPS will connect at startup. The URL syntax includes support for specifying a list of events to subscribe to and follows this pattern: **\[fs://\]\[\[username\]:password@\]host\[:port\]\[?event1\[,event2\]...\]**
exported_parameters.notes: This parameter can be set multiple times.

exported_functions.name: freeswitch_esl

parameters.name: command
parameters.description: the ESL command string to execute.

parameters.name: freeswitch_url
parameters.description: the ESL interface to connect to. The syntax is: [fs://][[username]:password@]host[:port][?event1[,event2]...]. The "?events" part of the URL will be silently discarded.

parameters.name: response_var
parameters.description: a variable which will hold the text result of the ESL command.

return_values.condition: success - the ESL command executed successfully and any output variables were successfully written to. Note that this does not say anything about the nature of the ESL answer (it may well be a "-ERR" type of response)
failure - internal error or the ESL command failed to execute

exported_functions.description:
Run an arbitrary command on an arbitrary FreeSWITCH ESL socket. The socket need not necessarily be defined in the database or through fs_subscribe. However, if this is the case, then the "password" part of the URL becomes mandatory.

The current OpenSIPS worker will block until an answer from FreeSWITCH arrives. The timeout for this operation can be controlled via the esl_cmd_timeout parameter of the freeswitch connection manager module.

exported_mi_functions.name: fs_subscribe

parameters.name: freeswitch_url
parameters.description: the ESL interface to connect to. The syntax is: [fs://][[username]:password@]host[:port][?event1[,event2]...]. The "?events" part of the URL will be silently discarded.

parameters.name: event
parameters.description: the name of the event to subscribe to

exported_mi_functions.description: Ensures that the given FreeSWITCH ESL socket is subscribed to the given list of events. In case an event cannot be subscribed to, the freeswitch driver will periodically retry to subscribe to it until an fs_unsubscribe MI command for the respective event is issued.

exported_mi_functions.name: fs_unsubscribe

parameters.name: freeswitch_url
parameters.description: the ESL interface to search for. The syntax is: [fs://][[username]:password@]host[:port][?event1[,event2]...]. The "?events" part of the URL will be silently discarded.

parameters.name: event
parameters.description: the name of the event to unsubscribe from

exported_mi_functions.description: Ensures that the given FreeSWITCH ESL socket is unsubscribed from the given list of events.

exported_mi_functions.name: fs_list
exported_mi_functions.description: Displays the current set of FreeSWITCH ESL sockets and the list of events that the module is subscribed to for each socket.

exported_mi_functions.name: fs_reload
exported_mi_functions.description:
Replaces the current set* of FreeSWITCH ESL sockets along with their respective events with the current data (ESL sockets and their events) found in the "freeswitch" table.
* this includes any sockets/events provisioned through fs_subscribe, MI fs_subscribe commands or previous DB data set.

exported_events.name: E_FREESWITCH
exported_events.description: This event is raised when OpenSIPS receives an ESL event notification from a socket that the "freeswitch_scripting" module is subscribed to.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: the full JSON-encoded body of the event, as sent by FreeSWITCH. Use the json module ($json variable) to easily interpret it.
